note: Source for contracts/boundaries.md. Edit here, then run python _tools/boundary_sheets.py. Examples are taken from contracts/fixtures. Optional request_case and result_case pick which fixture example is shown, as {"valid": index, "invalid": index}.

boundaries.name: Client starts a run
boundaries.failure: Sender: show the error and do not retry on its own; a lost response is recovered by sending the same request_id and bytes again. Receiver: reject before any record is written if the request is invalid or the token is wrong. Exit codes: 2 launch or configuration rejected, 4 environment unavailable.

boundaries.name: Benchmark client runs a task headless
boundaries.failure: Same request id and bytes returns the same handle. Changed bytes returns REQUEST_CONFLICT. Exit codes 0 success, 2 rejected, 3 halted, 4 environment unavailable.

boundaries.name: Supervisor freezes a plan
boundaries.failure: Any unresolved capsule, type mismatch or missing Gate returns a failure and writes no Binding. The batch is all or nothing.

boundaries.name: Supervisor asks the planner for a DAG
boundaries.failure: A planner failure or timeout halts the run before any planned node starts. The proposal is not authority.

boundaries.name: Supervisor validates the proposal
boundaries.failure: INVALID returns findings and the run dispatches nothing from the plan.

boundaries.name: Supervisor dispatches a node to the runner
boundaries.transport: authenticated local socket, length-prefixed frames (4-byte big-endian length, then UTF-8 JSON; max cc.ipc.max_frame_bytes, 1 MiB by default; large values by ref)
boundaries.failure: A complete response needs a committed Observation. A missing response is never a reason to run again. Duplicates attach to the first call.

boundaries.name: Runner talks to a tool child
boundaries.transport: inherited socket pair, length-prefixed frames (4-byte big-endian length, then UTF-8 JSON; max cc.ipc.max_frame_bytes, 1 MiB by default; large values by ref)
boundaries.failure: An unknown frame kind, an oversize frame or a missing heartbeat kills the child tree and ends the call with a typed error.

boundaries.name: Runner or planner asks the model bridge for one turn
boundaries.transport: authenticated local socket, length-prefixed frames (4-byte big-endian length, then UTF-8 JSON; max cc.ipc.max_frame_bytes, 1 MiB by default; large values by ref)
boundaries.failure: Timeout, auth loss or provider error returns a typed state. The bridge never resubmits a paid turn on its own.

boundaries.name: Supervisor asks the Gate host to check a call
boundaries.failure: A Gate that cannot save its Verification returns no success. Only ADVANCE with a committed Verification releases a node.

boundaries.name: Supervisor records a release or phase start
boundaries.failure: A failed write is a halt. The same id with different bytes is a conflict, never an overwrite.

boundaries.name: Supervisor hands accepted results to delivery
boundaries.failure: A file whose hash differs from its source ref fails the delivery. Output is written once, atomically.

boundaries.name: RSI controller scores a candidate
boundaries.transport: private authenticated socket, length-prefixed frames (4-byte big-endian length, then UTF-8 JSON; max cc.ipc.max_frame_bytes, 1 MiB by default; large values by ref)
boundaries.failure: Counts only, never per-case data. An interrupted query still uses its quota. A security violation blocks the session until a human clears it.

boundaries.name: RSI controller submits a candidate to admission
boundaries.failure: Integrity checks run first. A failure returns a rejected Verdict and no provider is asked.

boundaries.name: Human activates an admitted version
boundaries.failure: A stale expected hash returns STORE_CONFLICT. Activation changes future snapshots only.

boundaries.name: Supervisor starts generated-code execution
boundaries.transport: authenticated local socket, length-prefixed frames (4-byte big-endian length, then UTF-8 JSON; max cc.ipc.max_frame_bytes, 1 MiB by default; large values by ref)
boundaries.failure: Timeout kills the whole process tree. Unsupported security profile returns UNSUPPORTED_SECURITY_PROFILE and nothing runs.

boundaries.name: Launcher takes in a request and its files
boundaries.failure: Empty prompt, unreadable folder or oversize file is rejected before any capsule runs.

boundaries.name: Runner reports a progress event
boundaries.failure: Events may be dropped. Nothing may depend on one. State is read from records.

boundaries.name: Gate host runs the deterministic checks
boundaries.failure: A check that fails or cannot run is a result, never an exception. A judged check in the request is refused.

boundaries.name: Capsule asks for a search through the broker
boundaries.transport: tool host frame via the broker, length-prefixed frames (4-byte big-endian length, then UTF-8 JSON; max cc.ipc.max_frame_bytes, 1 MiB by default; large values by ref)
boundaries.failure: A partial scholarly outage returns state partial with an issue. Refused calls name the denied effect.

boundaries.name: Startup runs the doctor
boundaries.failure: A non-PASS mandatory check blocks the execution profiles it names. ready is true only when every mandatory check passes.

boundaries.name: Runner commits through the supervisor
boundaries.transport: authenticated local socket, length-prefixed frames (4-byte big-endian length, then UTF-8 JSON; max cc.ipc.max_frame_bytes, 1 MiB by default; large values by ref)
boundaries.failure: The runner holds no store write access. The supervisor checks run_id, dispatch_id and obs_id against the dispatch reservation, re-hashes the staged bytes and commits. A hash mismatch or unknown dispatch returns refused; the same record id with different bytes returns conflict. Neither is retried automatically. The runner sends a complete response only after its Observation commit returned committed.

boundaries.name: RSI controller runs an oracle session
boundaries.transport: private authenticated socket, length-prefixed frames (4-byte big-endian length, then UTF-8 JSON; max cc.ipc.max_frame_bytes, 1 MiB by default; large values by ref)
boundaries.failure: Calls run in this order: begin_session (oracle_begin_request), evaluate x n (oracle_evaluate_request, at most 30 queries per session), close_session (oracle_close_request), finish_close (oracle_finish_close_request), then evaluate_final (oracle_final_request, custodian channel only, once per closed session). A call out of order, a second final or a different byte string under an existing request_id is refused (REQUEST_CONFLICT or FINAL_SET_LOCKED). An uncleared security latch refuses begin_session with RSI_SECURITY_CLEARANCE_REQUIRED. Evaluate and final replies are oracle_aggregate_result: counts only, never per-case data.

boundaries.name: Runner or planner polls a model bridge turn
boundaries.transport: authenticated local socket, length-prefixed frames (4-byte big-endian length, then UTF-8 JSON; max cc.ipc.max_frame_bytes, 1 MiB by default; large values by ref)
boundaries.failure: A status request names the turn by target_request_id and carries no prompt. It never starts or resubmits a paid turn. The reply is queued, running or a final state (complete, cancelled, unavailable, timed_out, denied); a turn still queued or running at its deadline is treated by the caller as unavailable. cancel uses the same shape with operation cancel.
